headline: Beirut Restaurant Sells 20,000 Luxury Chicken Sandwiches Amid Financial Divide
summary: A Beirut health restaurant sold over 20,000 $13 chicken sandwiches in 11 days, highlighting a stark economic divide in Lebanon where many households struggle to afford essentials.
why: Disparities in consumer spending patterns in crisis-hit economies illustrate uneven wealth distribution and the persistence of localized inflationary pressures.
